cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Try this banking-delay explanation for the missing raffle money on the chair before I sign it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not defending your accounts again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Just test the explanation. If she accepts it, I'll sign and handle every question.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll recognise your handwriting before I speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the paper. Ask whether a banking delay sounds plausible. If she asks whose money, come back before answering.

mechanism: A orders B to expose a financial explanation to scrutiny while withholding A's own identifying commitment.
confusable: Unlike full delegation, A makes signing and owning questions conditional on B's prior successful test.
comparison: A document's handwriting threatens anonymity, unlike family flight spending tested through a sibling.
seedUse: The seed already directs a trial explanation, removes identifying paper and requires B return before disclosure; S01 reinforces that command.
